name: Wisconsin Steel Fabrication LLC
description: Wisconsin Steel Fabrication LLC is a steel fabrication and manufacturing company in Omro, Wisconsin. We handle everything from large modular and  construction projects all the way down to small repair work and support members for residential projects. We are a family business run by two brothers born and raised in Berlin WI. Since our inception in a small 900 sq ft, back yard garage with just a few welders, and a small forklift, we have proven that no job is too big or too small for us to be able to tackle. We now have grown to a 12 acre, 25,000 square ft facility with cutting edge equipment and experienced staff. We pride ourselves on Quality and on time delivery. Customer satisfaction is extremely important to us, after all without the customer you do not have a business. Bring us any project or idea and we will find a way to help you make it happen!
